title.zh: 将高山省 Bauko 市镇 Tapapan 描笼涯的 Guinzadan 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Tapapan 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Guinzadan National High School - Tapapan Annex in Barangay Tapapan, Municipality of Bauko, Mountain Province from the Guinzadan National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to Be Known as Tapapan National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Guinzadan National High School - Tapapan Annex in Barangay Tapapan, Municipality of Bauko, Mountain Province from the Guinzadan National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to Be Known as Tapapan National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Tapapan của Trường Trung học Guinzadan Quốc gia tại Barangay Tapapan, Đô thị Bauko, Tỉnh Mountain Province khỏi Trường Trung học Guinzadan Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Tapapan Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Tapapan ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Guinzadan แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Tapapan เทศบาล Bauko จังหวัด Mountain Province ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Guinzadan แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Tapapan แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Tapapan, Sekolah Menengah Guinzadan Nasional di Barangay Tapapan, Kotamadya Bauko, Provinsi Mountain Province dari Sekolah Menengah Guinzadan Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Tapapan Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. - The Guinzadan National High School - Tapapan Annex in Barangay Tapapan, Municipality of Bauko, Mountain Province is hereby separated from the Guinzadan National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Tapapan National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. - All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Guinzadan National High School - Tapapan Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Tapapan National High School.

Appropriations. The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Tapapan National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Guinzadan National High School - Tapapan Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
